mapper.select: select t2.tpl_id as queryTplId, t2.tpl_name queryTplName, t5.menu_id as analysisMenuId, t5.menu_name as analysisMenuName, t1.analysis_tpl_id as analysisTplId, t5.menu_name as analysisTplName from bi_ssm.ssm_analysis_tpl_widget_query_tpl_rel t1 inner join bi_ssm.ssd_query_template t2 on t1.prod_query_tpl_id = t2.tpl_id inner join bi_ssm.ssm_analysis_tpl_cfg_prod t4 on t1.analysis_tpl_id = t4.analysis_tpl_id and t1.analysis_tpl_cfg_id = t4.analysis_tpl_cfg_id inner join bi_ssm.ssm_portal_menu t5 on t4.analysis_tpl_id = t5.content_ref_id inner join bi_ssm.ssm_analysis_tpl_cache_cfg t6 on t5.menu_id = t6.analysis_tpl_menu_id where 1=1 and t4.is_latest = 1 and t5.is_active = 1 and t6.is_active = 1

select t1.query_tpl_id as queryTplId, t1.query_tpl_name as queryTplName, t1.analysis_menu_id as analysisMenuId, t1.analysis_menu_name as analysisMenuName, t1.analysis_tpl_id as analysisTplId, t1.analysis_tpl_name as analysisTplName, t1.etl_jobs as etlJobs, t1.cache_key as cacheKey, t1.remark as remark, t1.is_active as isActive from bi_ssm.ssm_query_tpl_cache_result t1 where t1.is_active = 1 and t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(now(), interval -2 day)
mapper.insert: insert into bi_ssm.ssm_query_tpl_cache_result( pkid, cache_id, query_tpl_id, query_tpl_name, analysis_menu_id, analysis_menu_name, analysis_tpl_id, analysis_tpl_name, etl_jobs, cache_sql, cache_key, cache_size, remark, is_active, created_by, created_time ) values( #{pkId}, #{cacheId}, #{queryTplId}, #{queryTplName}, #{analysisMenuId}, #{analysisMenuName}, #{analysisTplId}, #{analysisTplName}, #{etlJobs}, #{cacheSql}, #{cacheKey}, #{cacheSize}, #{remark}, 1, #{createdBy}, now() )
